none_due: Everything is OK — no maintenance needs attention.
none_due_mine: Nothing is assigned to you right now.
none_due_here: Nothing needs maintenance in this room.
unknown_user: I don't know who is asking, so I can't tell which tasks are yours.
unknown_area: I don't know which room this device is in — assign it to an area first.
postpone_needs_when: Tell me how far to postpone it — for example, by five days.
postpone_past: That would put '{task}' in the past.
skipped: Skipped this cycle of '{task}' on {object}. The next one is due {date}.
not_found: I couldn't find a maintenance task matching '{name}'.
ambiguous: That matches several tasks: {candidates}. Say which one, for example “{example}”.
too_early: '{task}' can only be completed closer to its due date.
guide_none: There are no stored instructions, documents or spare parts for '{task}' on {object}. I can offer general, non-verified advice instead — would you like that?
guide_url: a documentation link is on file
snoozed: Snoozed reminders for '{task}' on {object} for {hours} hours.
snooze_unavailable: Notifications aren't configured, so there is nothing to snooze.
stock_low: — at or below the reorder threshold
part_not_found: I couldn't find a spare part matching '{name}'.
completed_phase: Completed '{task}' on {object} — step done: {phase}. Next time: {next}.
part_ambiguous: That matches several spare parts: {candidates}. Say which one, for example “{example}”.
snoozed_one: Snoozed reminders for '{task}' on {object} for one hour.
guide_none_plain: There are no stored instructions, documents or spare parts for '{task}' on {object}.
none_due_window: Nothing is due in that time.
unknown_area_name: I don't know an area called '{area}'.
reading_multi: '{task}' records several readings — enter them in the Maintenance panel.
reading_unclear: I didn't catch a number in '{value}'.
note_too_long: The notes of '{task}' are full — shorten them in the Maintenance panel first.
buy_none: Nothing is running low — no spare parts need buying.
buy_list_one: One spare part is running low: {items}.
undo_none: There is nothing of yours to undo from the last {minutes} minutes.
undo_changed: '{task}' has changed since, so I left it as it is.
undone_completed: Undone: '{task}' on {object} is no longer completed.
undone_reading: Undone: the reading for '{task}' on {object} is removed.
undone_skipped: Undone: '{task}' on {object} is no longer skipped.
undone_postponed: Undone: '{task}' on {object} is back on its old date.
undone_snoozed: Undone: reminders for '{task}' on {object} are on again.
undone_note: Undone: the note on '{task}' on {object} is removed.
undone_bought: Undone: took {qty} × {part} back out of stock.
